$comment: Global weather dynamics, PRD section 3. Zone wind state machine runs every checkEveryHours; storms follow Atlantic hurricane climatology (season Jun-Nov, peak Aug-Oct). Expected spawns: ~3.6 storms per season.

storms.$comment: The real main development region lies far east of the map; storms enter here already formed. Late-season (Oct-Nov) western-Caribbean genesis is not modelled. Forward speed 250-550 km/day is ~10-23 km/h; most Caribbean storms recurve near 25-30N.
